quest.title: To My Old Friend, Wind Brings My Greetings
quest.description: After receiving your help, Millelith is finally able to assign a little group to reinforce their defenses around the city. Unsatisfied with the lack of effort from them, you've come back to the area hoping to find more clues. To your surprise, you met Xiao, a Liyue adeptus who also has the same intention as you. You both discovered that there are some markings at the corners of the construction site. "If a shackle within the realm of deities and demons got loose, I shall take full responsibility." "But this time, the threat comes from the mortal world —— your world, and thus, you shall take full responsibility, mortal traveler." said the adeptus to you. To decipher the markings and to learn its origin, you're reminded of that person that you've met in Mondstadt, a knight who prioritizes results above all else without caring about every trivial law...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, are you ready to go on a journey? It's time to go back to Mondstadt and find Kaeya.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: #Well, well, long time no see, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kaeya, we went to the Lantern Rite in Liyue!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Ah. Well, how was it? Fun?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Delicious!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Well then, you ought to be looking forward to Mondstadt's Ludi Harpastum. I'm sure it will be to your liking.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Get to the point, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, right! Kaeya, there's something we need to tell you about.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hmm... Lantern supplies... Stockpile of wood, paper, and oil... At the very least, it sounds like an accident waiting to happen.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Haha, how very amusing. What makes you think I would recognize this symbol?

choices.text: You're amazing at everything and we trust you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, that about sums it up!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Hah. I'm flattered, but don't you think you might be overestimating me?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There it is! At last, Kaeya displays the knightly virtue of modesty, perfectly articulated and masterfully delivered.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: My goodness, your stay in Liyue seems to have sharpened your wit and broadened your vocabulary.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Anyway, I digress. This is the symbol of the cross-border criminal organization you know as the Treasure Hoarders.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: If you are curious to know more, I can put you in touch with an informant on the inside.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh, didn't you just say the Knights of Favonius don't have dealings with their enemies!?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: ...This is my own personal informant. Nothing to do with the Knights of Favonius.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: A little later, make your way over to Windrise. I'll arrange for the informant to meet you there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thanks, Kaeya.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Oh, and remember: "wine begets wisdom."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh?

choices.text: You flirt with the dark side, so you would know.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Uh-ah! You should watch what you say, Honorary Knight.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: What do you mean, flirt with the dark side? The Knights of Favonius certainly does not have dealings with its enemies.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: That has to do with a certain knightly virtue called "integrity."

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Huh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! You're the guy, right? Kaeya's informant?

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Informant? Not me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... This is the place we agreed upon... and you're the only other one here, so...

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: "Place we agreed upon"? Heh, I know nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, stop being so annoying!

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Okay. Yeah, it's me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How was any of that even slightly necessary!?

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: What do you want to know about?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Here's the situation...

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Okay. I see.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So? What can you tell us as an insider?

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: I do not think this is the work of the Treasure Hoarders.

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: The reason the Treasure Hoarders are able to sustain a giant cross-border operation is because they abide by one fundamental principle:

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Caution. Softly softly catchee monkey is the name of the game for them. By contrast, the idea of taking huge risks to try and make a fortune is utter folly in their eyes.

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Liyue has the adepti looking after it, doesn't it? And they're especially active during the Lantern Rite...

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: There's just no way that we... sorry, "they"! Slip of the tongue — when you've been undercover as long as I have, heh, where was I... Oh, yes — There's just no way that they — the Treasure Hoarders — would dare make a move during the Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Also... the Treasure Hoarders' organization in Liyue recently received an anonymous letter.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why would someone send them an anonymous letter? Trying to frame them, perhaps?

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Nobody knows. But what I can tell you is which branch of the Treasure Hoarders has the letter in their possession.

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: ...There. I've marked their location on the map for you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Great. Well, Paimon thinks this was productive! {NICKNAME}, this is our only solid lead. Let's not waste it!

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: If there's nothing more, I should get back to treasure hoarding. ...I mean, get back to those treasure-hoarding lowlifes. To spy on them. Heh.

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Uh...

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Okay... technically the wrong password, but... yes, it's something about wine, and assuming that something is the thing about it begetting wisdom, then...

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Yeah, close enough. It's me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How was any of that even slightly necessary!?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: What's the matter, Paimon? Did your investigation reach a dead end?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes. It seems like this wasn't the Treasure Hoarders after all.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Well, I have some good news that might cheer you up. It came in just while you were out.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: It's from a... business associate of mine in Liyue. Who knows, you might find it helpful.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh what is it, what is it?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: The Treasure Hoarders' organization in Liyue has received an anonymous letter.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: I can only give you the letter's location. It is beyond my ability to find out its contents.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #No problemo! {NICKNAME}, this is our only solid lead. Let's not waste it!

talks.objective: Locate the Treasure Thieves using the information
Talk to the member of Treasure Thieves

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: Sorry mate, wrong way. Wherever you think you're going, it's that way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But isn't that the way to Liyue Harbor?

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: Right. Here is nowhere. So the other way is Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Crafty
dialogues.text: If you're looking for somewhere to stay, I suggest you go to the Wangshu Inn. Fair prices, great customer service, and a wonderful view.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Show us the anonymous letter.

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: ...How do you know about the letter?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Uh, one of Liyue's adepti told us about it!

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: Did they now? I somehow doubt that.
You should not doubt it. It was I who sent them to investigate.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Any further questioning, you may direct to me.

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: ...You're the Vigilant Yaksha!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, watch your tone of voice! Or do you seriously wanna pick a fight with an adeptus?

dialogues.speaker: Crafty
dialogues.text: Uh, okay. It's not that we don't believe you're an adeptus, it's just... Everyone needs to look at the bigger picture here.

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: As you well know, we Treasure Hoarders are no serious threat to anyone. We're petty criminals, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Crafty
dialogues.text: So if you are truly an adeptus, please... Show us some mercy, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: Of course, if it turns out you're not a real adeptus...

dialogues.speaker: Crafty
dialogues.text: Then please, don't blame our weapons for treating everyone equally...

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: Please, oh great one! Heroic Yaksha of Liyue! Divine Adeptus and friend of the people! Have mercy!

dialogues.speaker: Crafty
dialogues.text: The letter is drivel anyway! It's not worth an armed conflict... Just take it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How about that — Paimon knew it all along!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Let's see what they wrote, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I see. Then let us send these two to the meeting.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: The sender may be plotting something truly diabolical for the Lantern Rite. It seems they want to burn down the entire city.

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: Great, everyone's happy. You're good, we're good. However...

dialogues.speaker: Crafty
dialogues.text: These two... They don't look anything like us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It'll be fine. When we're in disguise, no-one will be the wiser.

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: It still seems like a long shot to me, but... with the help of an adeptus, hopefully everything will turn out fine...

dialogues.speaker: Crafty
dialogues.text: Well, the safety of Liyue is in your hands now. Good luck — even the Treasure Hoarders don't want to see the city burned to the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Then it is settled.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: *sigh* What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Next time we meet...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's make it somewhere with a view of the Mingxiao Lantern.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...I am not partial to crowded areas. Especially at this time of the year.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Must we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...Understood. I shall await your news there.
